name: Linear Support Sentiment to Slack
description: Track the sentiment of recently updated Linear issue conversations in Airtable and send aggregated Slack alerts when their sentiment turns negative.
requirements: Linear connection with issue/comment read access; source first50 issues and first50 comments per issue retained
Airtable base/table with documented sentiment columns and a Last Modified time field; shared read/write/poll connection and atomic upsert Proxy permission
Slack user connection with chat:write and access to the alert channel
gpt-5-mini model route; analysis every30minutes and change polling hourly, initially UTC
Unique Issue ID per Airtable row; avoid overlapping analyses and inspect uncertain external write results before replay

source.path: Slack/Sentiment Analysis Tracking on Support Issues with Linear and Slack.json
